tone_rows.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in t
tone_rows.label: to Photius
tone_rows.modern:
Let us praise the most holy Photius with Godly hymns:
He is the instrument of grace,
the harp of the spirit,
the immovable pillar of the divine faith,
the champion of true worship,
the great teacher, glorious and holy hierarch,
the confirmation of the Church,//
the most splendid contender for the Lord!

tone_rows.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in t
tone_rows.label: to Photius
tone_rows.modern:
With one voice, all Orthodox,
let us praise Photius with sacred hymns:
He is the first enthroned among the patriarchs,
an orator of fiery spirit,
a teacher of the whole world,
the godly primate of Constantinople,
a brilliant bishop,//
the most excellent pastor of the Church of Christ!

tone_rows.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in t
tone_rows.label: to Photius
tone_rows.modern:
You were driven from your flock by an evil command, glorious one,
and shared in sorrows and tribulations for the faith.
Most steadfast Photius, illustrious bishop,
confirmation of the Church and immovable pillar!
Therefore we all fervently honor you as a teacher of the Orthodox Faith//
and an expounder of the mysteries, ever-memorable one!

tone_rows.title: Martyrs Manuel, Sabel, and Ismael, of Pers
tone_rows.label: Anatolian
tone_rows.modern:
The glorious martyrs desired You, Word of God,
with singleness of mind!
They did not trouble themselves to worship fire.
The glorious Manuel, the ever-memorable Sabel and thrice-blessed Ismael
left the land of the Chaldeans:
They were enlightened by Your light
and were armed with the weapons of the faith!
They shamed the despotic Julian, singing hymns to you
together with the Father and the Spirit.//
Now they intercede that our souls may be saved!

tone_rows.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother
tone_rows.label: of the Dormition
tone_rows.modern:
Come, let us keep the feast shared by all the world,
of the Dormition of the all-pure Theotokos!
Today angels celebrate the sacred translation of the Mother of God,
summoning us earth-born mortals to the festivity,
that we may cry out with ceaseless voices:
Rejoice, for you have been translated from the earth,
and changed your abode to the heavenly mansions!
Rejoice, for you have brought together the choir of apostles
through a bright cloud!
Rejoice, our hope and protection!//
For we, the Christian people, never cease to bless you!

tone_rows.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother
tone_rows.label: of the Dormition
tone_rows.modern:
It was right that the eye-witnesses and ministers of the Word
should see the Dormition of His Mother according to the flesh:
The final mystery concerning her!
So that they might be witnesses not only of the Ascension of the Savior,
but also to the translation of her who gave Him birth.
Assembled from all parts by divine power, they came to Zion,
and sped on her way to heaven the Virgin who is higher than the cherubim.//
We also venerate her, for she prays for our souls.

tone_rows.title: Protomartyr and Equal of the Apostles Thek
tone_rows.modern:
You trampled on the attacks of lions,
putting your fallen nature to shame,
greatly-suffering Protomartyr!
You followed after your Bridegroom, crying aloud:
I run after the fragrance of Your myrrh, O Christ!
You sought out Paul and received a gift from heaven!
You were given a crown by God Who judges the contest!
You ever intercede for us //
that forgiveness of sins may be granted to those who celebrate your memory in faith!

tone_rows.title: Hieromartyr Cyprian, Virgin Martyr Justina
tone_rows.modern:
Through the anointing of the priesthood
and the blood of martyrdom,
you drew near to God, most perfect and all-glorious Cyprian!
You are the flower of nature;
the adornment of preaching,
the summit of wisdom and a rule of true dogmas,
a harmoniser of the canons://
You are the splendor of the churches!

tone_rows.title: Hieromartyr Cyprian, Virgin Martyr Justina
tone_rows.modern:
Most honorable Cyprian,
glory of athletes and crown of martyrs:
By your sermons you persuaded the divinely wise
to maintain their courage most valiantly
in the face of imprisonment, bondage and varied tortures,
nakedness, binding and bitter cold,//
with wounding and death at the end.

tone_rows.title: Hieromartyr Cyprian, Virgin Martyr Justina
tone_rows.modern:
You are the splendor of virgins and martyrs, Justina!
You opposed the spells of demons with hymns to the Spirit!
By the sign of the Cross,
you preserved your virginity,
offering yourself to Christ as a most holy sacrifice!
You are an unconquered martyr,//
receiving the crowns of victory!

tone_rows.title: Martyr Arethas and 4,299 Martyrs with him
tone_rows.modern:
You opposed your courage, most praised Martyr Arethas,
to the savagery of evil men!
By the grace of God, you were shown to be victorious!
Glorious one, you brought to Christ,//
a choir of martyrs formed by soldiers of all ages and races!

tone_rows.title: Martyr Arethas and 4,299 Martyrs with him
tone_rows.modern:
You formed a beautiful choir, most glorious Arethas
of your holy fellow martyrs!
You struggled with them, completing the good race
and the good fight of your courageous contest!//
Therefore entreat Christ that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

tone_rows.title: Martyr Arethas and 4,299 Martyrs with him
tone_rows.modern:
The godly minded virgin martyrs
enkindled by the love of Christ,
did not heed the weakness of their nature.
Manifestly strengthened by the power of God
they trampled down the delusion of the enemy!
They were not afraid of the pain of torture//
and did not fear the fiery furnace!

tone_rows.title: Saint Paul the Confessor, Archbishop of Co
tone_rows.podoben: You Have Given Us A Sign
tone_rows.modern:
The divinely-eloquent Paul ordains you, most blessed one,
as his namesake and follower!
You are adorned with his character and piety,
his endurance through tribulations!
Aflame with his zeal, you are a champion of Orthodoxy!//
Now you are glorified with him in the heavenly mansions!

tone_rows.title: Saint Paul the Confessor, Archbishop of Co
tone_rows.podoben: You Have Given Us A Sign
tone_rows.modern:
You strangled the ungodly Arius and the impious Macedonius
with the strong cords of your teachings!
With your true words of doctrine,
you strengthened multitudes of the Orthodox faithful,
Hieromartyr and Father!
Therefore, the Lover of mankind accepted your brilliant confession,//
revealing you to be a dweller in His Kingdom!

tone_rows.title: Saint Paul the Confessor, Archbishop of Co
tone_rows.podoben: You Have Given Us A Sign
tone_rows.modern:
Christ has crowned you with a bright wreath of righteousness, blessed bishop!
You have kept the faith; you have finished your course,
and He has adorned your confession, truly wondrous one!
Therefore, since you have received your inheritance in heaven,//
pray to the Savior for those who sing praises to you!

tone_rows.title: Saint Paul the Confessor, Archbishop of Co
tone_rows.podoben: You Have Given Us A Sign
tone_rows.modern:
Most blessed Paul, the namesake of confession,
you are the intercessor for those who praise you in faith:
Deliver us from all misfortune and every sin,
from the storm of the passions and from tyranny,
for you are an invincible martyr, Father,
a rightly-accepted bishop!//
You have acquired boldness before Christ our God!
